slide1.headline: Anthropic Unveils Claude Opus 4.7

lines: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.7 on 16 Apr 2026

It has stronger coding and AI vision capabilities

slide1.headline: Manual AI Audits: A Compliance Liability
slide1.subtitle: The EU AI Act requires more than just spreadsheets

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 16 Apr 2026
The EU AI Act has strict compliance requirements for AI audits
Manual audits are no longer sufficient, with 100% of companies needing to upgrade their processes
Companies must implement automated auditing systems to ensure compliance
The EU AI Act requires transparent and explainable AI decision-making

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: Non-compliance can result in significant fines and reputational damage
Automated auditing systems can help companies ensure transparency and accountability in their AI decision-making
The EU AI Act is setting a new standard for AI regulation globally
Source: Security Boulevard, 16 Apr 2026

posts.caption: The EU AI Act requires companies to move beyond manual AI audits and implement automated systems to ensure compliance. This change is crucial for transparency and accountability in AI decision-making. Questions to consider: How will companies adapt to the new compliance requirements? What are the potential consequences of non-compliance? #AI #Compliance #EUAIAct #Regulation #Transparency #Accountability

Alpha Net Contracts will enhance Wipro's service offerings in the AI sector
